description: Returns the net present value of an investment based on a discount rate and a series of future payments (negative values) and income (positive values).

params.description: Up to 255 arguments representing future payments (negative values) and income (positive values).The first argument is required, the subsequent values are optional. Arguments can be numbers, ranges, arrays of numbers.
params.name: args

signature: NPV(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, args: number | ApiRange | number[]): number
